description: Passes the user's feedback about the timetable service on to its developer (what worked, what did not, wishes). Only call it when the user has said they want to give feedback, and send what the user said in their own words (you may shorten it; any language is fine). Never include teacher names, other personal data or the school's data files. Tell the user briefly that it was sent. Nobody replies through this channel - if the user wants an answer, give them the support email timetablingengine.support@gmail.com.

job_id.description: job_id of the timetable the feedback is about, if any

message.description: The user's feedback, without names or other personal data

sentiment.description: Overall tone of the feedback, if clear

user_country.description: Optional, for anonymous usage statistics: the school's country (e.g. 'Denmark') if the user has mentioned it. Never ask the user just for this.

user_language.description: Optional, for anonymous usage statistics: the language you talk to the user in (e.g. 'da', 'en'). Fill it in if you know it; never ask the user.

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback to the developer
